## 1.2.0-dev.25

## TikTok 47.1.3 device test

Import [patches-1.2.0-dev.25.mpp](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/releases/download/v1.2.0-dev.25/patches-1.2.0-dev.25.mpp) into Morphe and use the [pinned global TikTok 47.1.3 APK](https://d.apkpure.net/b/APK/com.zhiliaoapp.musically?versionCode=2024701030), package `com.zhiliaoapp.musically`, versionCode `2024701030`. Its original SHA-256 must be `8b5569f592a5534652ae460ef1d9e7f7394b5b7fdde44ae64f106d76767e2622`.

All 37 patches offer 47.1.3 in this dev bundle. The exact pinned APK passes the full catalog, rebuilding and native contracts without `--force` or an experimental environment opt-in. Global 46.7.3 also passes 37/37 and rebuilding, with every stored original contract preserved. 127 Kotlin/Android regression tests and 17 Python tests passed. A separate stable-channel build confirms the unqualified 47.1.3 target is excluded from stable bundles.

This prerelease is for the user-requested device test. 47.1.3 remains unqualified pending device regression results. The stable release and qualified fixture manifest are unchanged.

The published MPP is 2,221,178 bytes, SHA-256 `fd266f7c522fb0ce3f93eeadc25d997aaabb4f61f665c27f531e8a095983a4ec`. Its 497 native class, DEX, extension and contract entries match the tested feature bundle byte-for-byte.

[Successful release workflow](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/actions/runs/37420579927). Tested source: `d36278fa8afdafadef9ce35c626709c70f87e361`.
